name: XlEnableCancelKey
description: Specifies how Microsoft Office Excel 2007 handles CTRL+BREAK (or ESC or COMMAND+PERIOD) user interruptions to the running procedure.

constants.name: xlDisabled
constants.description: Cancel key trapping is completely disabled.

constants.name: xlErrorHandler
constants.description: The interrupt is sent to the running procedure as an error, trappable by an error handler set up with an On Error GoTo statement. The trappable error code is 18.

constants.name: xlInterrupt
constants.description: The current procedure is interrupted, and the user can debug or end the procedure.
